summary: Tested the SEO work and the Featured Programme master, backend and frontend. Backend: 16 of 16 pytest cases pass. Public GET featured-programme returns the 8 keys with the Kazakhstan defaults. Admin PUT saves and the change persists. A blank or missing title gives 422. Bad links (javascript:, http://, ftp://, relative without a leading /) give 422. Blank highlight rows are dropped. Requests with no auth, no CSRF token, or a vendor login give 401/403. The sitemap is valid XML with 12 static <loc> entries; every preview notice has 'Demo' in its title, so all are left out, as expected. The robots.txt API returns a Sitemap line, and the static /robots.txt file is served. Frontend: the home H1, both CTAs, the two-path cards and the featured programme section (title from the master, 4 items) all render. useSeo sets the title, meta description, og:title, canonical and JSON-LD. All 11 public pages have distinct titles ending '| PMC Managers · Global Tender Grid'; the notice detail title contains the notice title and ref. /buyers: 'Sample figures' is gone, buyers-how and 'Who it is for' are present, and buyers-pricing-link points to /pricing. /suppliers has no '29 tenders'. /about has no 'Kazakhstan'. /pricing shows public-chrome-signin and public-chrome-register. Admin flow at /admin/e/marketing?tab=programme: all fields are present; adding a highlight, changing the title and saving updates the home page (5 items); a bad brief URL shows a 422 toast; disabling removes the section from the home page. Restored to the defaults afterwards and confirmed through the API. Mobile 390px: grids stack to one column with no horizontal overflow. One minor design issue: on mobile, sections that use .lf-sec lose their vertical padding.

minor.issue: The test-title regex r'\btest|demo\b|sample\b|dummy' is uneven. 'Samples' and 'Demonstration' are not excluded, while 'dummy' matches anywhere in a word (and 'test' anywhere a word starts with it, e.g. 'testimonial'). It filters on title only; there is no flag for private or hidden notices. Consider an explicit is_test/exclude_from_sitemap flag, or \b(test|demo|sample|dummy)s?\b.

issues: Vertical padding drops to 0. RCA: the mobile rule '[data-ui="e"] .pmc-wrap{padding:0 20px}' in pmc-theme-e.css has higher specificity and overrides '.lf-sec{padding:64px 0}'. As a result, the 'Who it is for' eyebrow sits flush against the dark buyers-how band, and 'The platform' sits flush under the hero. Fix: add '@media (max-width:767px){[data-ui="e"] .pmc-wrap.lf-sec{padding:40px 20px}}'.
On the home page the 'For suppliers' nav item has class is-on (already there before this change). Since the home page now speaks to buyers and suppliers equally, no item should be highlighted.

action_items: Restore the vertical padding of .lf-sec on mobile (CSS specificity fix above).
Optional: tighten the sitemap test-title regex, or use an explicit exclusion flag.
Optional: remove is-on from 'For suppliers' in the HomeE header.
critical_code_review_comments: FeaturedProgramme.jsx uses key={x.title}. Two highlights with the same title trigger React key warnings; use the index or title+index.
Backend save_programme does not cap string lengths (title, summary, highlight text) and only caps highlights at 8 after filtering. Consider Pydantic max_length.
The FRONTEND_URL fallback in config.py is 'http://localhost:3000'. If the env var is missing in prod, the sitemap and robots would point to localhost. Fail fast instead.
The static public/robots.txt hard-codes https://www.pmcmanagers.com, so it differs from the API robots on preview. This is acceptable for prod.
test_credentials: adminsupport@pmcmanagers.com / Admin@12345 worked (admin login page uses placeholder-based inputs, Continue button)
